name: Shrimps à la Newburg
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Clean shrimps and cook three minutes in two tablespoons butter.
Add salt, cayenne, and lemon juice, and cook one minute.
Remove shrimps, and put remaining butter in chafing-dish, add flour and cream; when thickened, add yolks of eggs slightly beaten, shrimps, and wine.
Serve with toast or Puff Paste Points.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
